caption:
Boneless mutton ₹649 in Hyderabad, never frozen: mutton pepper fry, ready in 35 minutes 🐐🌶️ మటన్ మిరియాల వేపుడు

💬 Pepper fry with rice and dal, or with chapati? 👇

🛒 You need: 500 g goat boneless · 1 onion, sliced · 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste · ½ tsp turmeric · 1 tsp red chilli powder · 1½ tsp freshly crushed black pepper · 1 tsp coriander powder · a few curry leaves · salt · 3 tbsp oil
1️⃣ Pressure-cook mutton with turmeric, salt, ½ cup water: 4 whistles.
2️⃣ Fry onions and curry leaves golden; add ginger-garlic paste.
3️⃣ Add mutton, chilli and coriander powder; fry on high till dry.
4️⃣ Add crushed pepper, toss 3 min till dark and glossy. Top with coriander.
